description: Glyph and kerning changes drawn as pictures, and live previews of glyph and kerning files (UFO, .fontra, .glyphs, .glyphspackage)
config.glyphDiffMode: How the old and new outlines of a glyph are shown in the diff view.
config.glyphDiffMode.overlay: Both versions on top of each other
config.glyphDiffMode.sideBySide: The old version on the left, the new one on the right
config.showPoints: Show nodes and handles in glyph diffs and previews.
